title: Sub-groups and a quicker + button
summary: Split costs between just some of the people in a group, and start any record or a split bill straight from the + button.

sections.title: Split expenses
items: New sub-groups: track costs that only some people in a group shared, like a cab for three out of five
Each sub-group keeps its own expenses and who paid for them
Sub-group costs are settled together with the main group in Who pays whom

sections.title: Dashboard
items: The + button now opens a menu: Expense, Income, Transfer or Split a bill
Income and Transfer open straight on their own tab
Split a bill from the dashboard: add it to an open group or start a new one

title: A complete redesign
summary: Every screen has been rebuilt with a new design: new fonts, colourful category icons, and refreshed light and dark themes. Your records, accounts and budgets carry over as they are.

sections.title: Dashboard
items: Cleaner balance card with this month's income and expense
Records grouped by day, with an optional total beside each date
Record details, display options and confirmations now open as sheets
The + button tucks away while you scroll and comes back when you scroll up

sections.title: Add record
items: Amounts format as you type (1,24,560.50) and show in red or green
Choose the account and category from quick picker sheets
A transfer can't use the same account on both sides

sections.title: Statistics
items: New Categories, Trend and Accounts tabs
Category donut chart, monthly bar charts and a daily spending calendar
Tap a month in Trend to jump straight to it
Daily averages count only the days that have passed

sections.title: Budgets
items: New Past budgets view: how much you spent against your budget each month
"Almost used", "Limit reached" and "Over budget" labels on every category
Budget templates show their monthly total
The Set budget sheet shows last month's spend as a guide

sections.title: Accounts
items: New Wallet account type, alongside Bank, Cash, Card and Other
Each account type has its own colour throughout the app
Opening balances can be negative, for a card you owe on

sections.title: Categories
items: Pick a colour for any category
40+ new expense and income icons

sections.title: Split expenses
items: Redesigned groups, with Active and Settled sections
See what each person paid, gets back or owes, and expand to see their expenses
New "Who pays whom" screen with UPI pay links and QR codes
Show QR so a friend can pay you face to face
Refreshed shareable summary images

sections.title: Settings and data
items: Redesigned Preferences, Theme, Export, Backup & restore and Delete & reset screens
Refreshed PDF report layout
Delete & reset now asks you to type to confirm

title: Updates to 1.0
summary: The small releases between the first version and 2.0. They weren't written up at the time, so these notes are put together from the app's development history, month by month.

sections.title: September 2025
items: Statistics: an income and expense flow chart, and a bar chart for each account

sections.title: October 2025
items: Budgets: set a monthly limit for a category and see what is left
Backup and restore, so your records can move to a new phone
Export your records to a file
Delete and reset, to start over

sections.title: November 2025
items: A refreshed look for several screens

sections.title: February 2026
items: Split expenses: create a group, split bills between people and share the result as an image

sections.title: May 2026
items: Split expenses: save people once and reuse them across groups
A UPI QR code for each payment, so friends can settle up by scanning

sections.title: September 2026
items: Budget templates: save a month's limits and apply them to another month

sections.title: October 2026
items: UPI pay links alongside the QR codes when settling up

title: PennyLog is on Google Play
summary: The first public version: a simple, offline way to write down where your money goes.

sections.title: Records
items: Log expenses, income and transfers between your own accounts
Everything is saved on your phone and works without internet

sections.title: Accounts and categories
items: Keep cash, bank and wallet balances separately
Add your own income and expense categories with icons

sections.title: Statistics
items: See your spending by category in a chart

sections.title: Settings
items: Pick your currency when you start
A daily reminder to log the day's spending
Light and dark themes
